tool_return.title: Terry Dexter (album)
tool_return.text: Terry Dexter is the eponymous debut studio album by American contemporary R&B singer Terry Dexter, released July 13, 1999 via Warner Bros. Records. The album did not chart on the "Billboard" 200, but it peaked at #49 on the R&B chart.
